result.transversal_value: The evidence chain cleanly separates three layers that often get conflated: provider-authenticated release identity, exact file content identity, and a tiny text-semantic predicate. Scheduled Chat can certify small source/config facts from already-signed repository state without running language tooling, while refusing to promote source declarations into runtime/build outcomes.
result.scope: two leading declarations of one readable go.mod at one provider-verified signed-tag target
